description.p: AMR (Antigravity Manager Rust) is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance cross-platform AI protocol proxy and emulator written in pure Rust with a native Slint GUI.
Features include zero bloat, dual-mode reasoning effort parsing, multi-account quota balancing, hardware isolation, and seamless OpenAI and Anthropic Claude compatibility.
AMR v@VERSION@: Pure Rust AI API proxy, protocol emulator, multimodal audio/image support, and quota-aware dispatcher.
